Den vilsegångne hemma är,
0:00 / —
SV EN FR

This is a translation of the Swedish lyrics and cannot be sung.

1.

The wanderer is home, In the world he wanders no more. The lost son is dear to the Father In Thee, God’s precious Lamb, God’s Lamb.

2.

My soul, now saved from sin and death, Shall no more suffer hunger, It is satisfied with God’s own bread In Thee, O Thou God’s Lamb, God’s Lamb.

3.

No more separated from my Father, Though I wasted His possession, I am embraced by Him gently In Thee, God’s precious Lamb, God’s Lamb.

4.

And the festal robe He brings forth, He prepares a ring and shoes for me, And teaches me the children’s song of joy Of Thee, O Thou God’s Lamb, God’s Lamb.

5.

And now I stand in God’s favour, But I cannot fully comprehend The love I enjoy In Thee, God’s precious Lamb, God’s Lamb.

Text: Efter The wanderer no more will roam av Mary J. Walker, 1858. Musik: Woodworth av William B. Bradbury, 1849. 8.8.8.8
